title: Hell of a Week
description: Supernerd was hired to oversee the rebranding for the show Tha God's Honest Truth, which was being rebranded as "Hell of a Week"... or "Helluva Week"... or "One Hell of a Week"... Jump in to see the process and see what direction Comedy Central landed on with the rebranding of the show.

pieces.title: Season 2
pieces.description: The idea was to utilize Afro Futurism to represent the show, we used african inspired geometric patterns and cast them as glowing neon lines paired with glowing glitches to represent a futuristic african inspired look. The colors flip American Red White and Blue on its head.
